environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running as a systemd service under the 'appuser' account. The Flask app listens on port 8080 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no additional filtering. The instance has PostgreSQL client tools installed. The appuser has standard shell access and the instance IAM role has ec2:DescribeInstances and s3:GetObject permissions. Security group allows inbound TCP 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No request body validation middleware is configured.
